comment_1.text: Listen for the different viewpoints, and notice when the applicant learns what is happening.

comment_2.text: Now, you will hear four different voices, one after another. Each person will share their own view on what you just heard.
comment_2.source: design.md B-1(未承認・Trial-only、registryへ書かない)

comment_3.text: You have heard four different ways of experiencing the same situation. Instead of deciding which view is right, let us ask why the situation feels different to each person. Next, we will look more closely at where that difference comes from.
comment_3.source: design.md B-1(未承認・Trial-only、registryへ書かない)

comment_4.text: The important question is not only who is right. It is also what is making this situation possible.
